title: PlaytimePlus
description: A high-performance Minecraft plugin for tracking player playtime with zero lag and automated rewards. Features 1000+ scalable levels, smart reward systems, and a modern GUI experience.
body:
PlaytimePlus

Modern Playtime Tracking & Rewards System for Minecraft Servers

--- ## 🚀 Overview **PlaytimePlus** is a high-performance Minecraft plugin designed to track player playtime with **zero lag** and reward players automatically. Built for modern servers like **Paper** and **Purpur (1.20+)**, it delivers a **scalable progression system**, clean GUI, and powerful customization — all without performance issues. ---

## ⚡ Key Features - **Zero Lag Tracking** Uses native Minecraft statistics instead of heavy schedulers - **1000+ Auto-Generated Levels** Fully scalable progression system with balanced formulas - **Smart Reward Engine** Supports random rewards, chances, and custom milestone overrides - **Modern GUI System** Interactive menus with locked, ready, and claimed states - **Async Data Handling** Prevents server lag with fully asynchronous saving --- ## 🧠 Advanced System - Procedural reward generation (no manual config needed) - Override specific levels with custom rewards - Random rewards with configurable drop chances - Dynamic reward values using placeholders --- ## 🛠 Commands - `/playtime` → Open rewards GUI - `/pt` → Shortcut - `/playtime reload` → Reload configuration --- ## 🔧 Compatibility - ✔ Paper - ✔ Purpur - ✔ Minecraft 1.20+ --- ## 💎 Why Choose PlaytimePlus? - Lightweight and optimized - No lag, no bloat - Fully scalable system - Easy to configure - Designed for modern servers ---
